Select time observations based on date range

Source: R/select_by_dates.R
select_by_dates.Rd

Keeps the observations between two dates: the date columns of a wide table, or the layers of a raster.

Usage

select_by_dates(x, from = NULL, to = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
select_by_dates(x, from = NULL, to = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'SpatRaster'
select_by_dates(x, from = NULL, to = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A data frame with time-series data in wide format (one column per date), a c4e_tbl, or a SpatRaster with dates.

from

character. A string representing the start date (optional).

to

character. A string representing the end date (optional).

...

Unused.

Value

x restricted to the dates between from and to. Columns that are not dates are kept. A c4e_tbl records the new date range, and a raster keeps its context.

Details

The function requires both or just one between the starting date, from, and the end date to. If both are provide the the function select between the two dates. If only from is provided the function selects all date after. If only to is provided the function selects all date before. If none are provided returns the data unchanged.

Dates may be truncated, e.g. "2022" or "2022-06". Date columns are those whose name starts with a year, optionally after an X, so a column such as MAX_2020 is not taken for a date.

Examples

df <- data.frame(X2022.12 = c(100, 200),
                 X2022.06 = c(150, 250))

select_by_dates(df, from = "2022-06-01", to = "2022-12-31")
#>   X2022.12 X2022.06
#> 1      100      150
#> 2      200      250

tmax <- read_climate(
  system.file("extdata", "tmax_daily.tif", package = "c4e"))
#> Read tmax_daily: tmax [K], daily, 2021-01-01 to 2023-12-31, 1095 layers
#> (synthetic).
select_by_dates(tmax, from = "2023-06-01", to = "2023-06-30")
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 6, 6, 30  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 0.2, 0.2  (x, y)
#> extent      : 30, 31.2, -1, 0.2  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
#> source      : tmax_daily.tif
#> varname     : tmax (c4e:variable=tmax;kind=continuous;source=synthetic;label=tmax_daily;time_step=day)
#> names       : 2023-06-01, 2023-06-02, 2023-06-03, 2023-06-04, 2023-06-05, 2023-06-06, ...
#> min values  :  301.06424, 298.318298, 301.583649, 299.440399, 300.054596, 301.520966, ...
#> max values  : 309.571899, 309.351685, 308.339844, 311.700653, 309.410461, 310.114105, ...
#> unit        : K
#> time (days) : 2023-06-01 to 2023-06-30 (30 steps)
